events.evidence: Wachovia, the fourth largest bank in the United States, fires its Chief Executive Officer, G. Kennedy Thompson, due to losses incurred in the subprime mortgage crisis
new mortgage approvals in the United Kingdom in April were at record lows
A suicide bomber strikes outside the Danish embassy in the Pakistani capital Islamabad

label.note: Subprime losses hit Wachovia and UK mortgage approvals; Islamabad bombing adds geopolitical risk.
